dataset_name: Level Devil Authentic Troll Mechanics & Deception Dataset

stages.name: Level 10: Where Are You Going Now?

RUSHER.vulnerability: sprints blindly without checking floor or anticipating door shifts

CAUTIOUS.vulnerability: hesitates on platforms allowing pursuing hazards to trap them

HOPPER.vulnerability: commits to high jump arcs that collide into ceiling stalactites and landing spikes

CHAOTIC.vulnerability: unpredictable inputs easily derailed by inverted axes and runaway doors

METHODICAL.vulnerability: calculates static paths that fail when environment dynamically mutates
